name: Vale
lines: Kael: I have made a commitment to Mira. I cannot leave that outside this conversation.
Vale: Then don't. If that promise changes, she should hear it from you. I won't write myself into the space you leave unspoken.

actions.label: Then friendship, without a second promise.

relationship_event.text: Kael disclosed his commitment to Mira and chose friendship with Vale rather than making a second promise.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I'm glad there was no hidden sentence in that answer.
